create_BitConfig: create a BitConfig instance with default BiT model settings for google/bit-50
initialize_BitConfig_custom: initialize BitConfig with custom layer_type, hidden_sizes, and depth parameters
validate_BitConfig_architecture: validate BitConfig architecture by checking layer_type and global_padding values
configure_BitConfig_backbone: configure BitConfig backbone output features and output indices via set_output_features_output_indices
customize_BitConfig_parameters: customize BitConfig parameters including num_groups, drop_path_rate, and width_factor
